description: This file defines structures and functions related to calculating Transport Block Size (TBS) for 3GPP LTE/NR shared channels (PDSCH and PUSCH). It includes configuration parameters, conversion functions, and TBS determination methods.

classes.name: tbs_calculator_configuration
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for TBS calculation, including OFDM symbols, REs, modulation, layers, scaling, and PRB count.

methods.name: tbs_calculator_pdsch_get_scaling_factor
methods.description: Converts TB scaling field into the scaling factor S based on 3GPP TS38.214.

methods.name: tbs_calculator_table_find_smallest_not_less_than
methods.description: Finds the smallest TBS in bits from the TS38.214 table that is greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: tbs_calculator_calculate
methods.description: Calculates the transport block size (TBS) in bits for a given configuration.
